evidence.title: Hyperbrowser - Web Infra for AI Agents

name: Hyperbrowser
summary: Cloud browser sessions, scraping, agent sandboxes and MCP tools for AI automation, with Python and Node SDKs.
description: Cloud browsers for AI agents and automation: managed browser sessions that Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium connect to, scraping and multi-page crawling to HTML, markdown or structured data with AI extraction schemas, the open-source Playwright-powered HyperAgent framework, and sandboxes for agent code execution. Python and Node.js SDKs, a REST API, MCP tools and the hx CLI; built by S2 Labs Inc.
contains: managed cloud browser sessions (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium)
scrape to HTML, markdown or structured data; AI extraction with schemas
sandboxes for agent code execution, with SDKs and the hx CLI
stealth mode with anti-detection and residential or datacenter proxies
Python and Node.js SDKs plus REST API and MCP tools
credits-based service pricing with public tiers
